'''Surabat''' was a tiny settlement located in the [[Surabat River Valley]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]]. Its residents were hardy and reserved folks, many of whom were involved in the dangerous task of harvesting the [[Golden Lichen]] that grew on the spires that surrounded the vicinity.

==Description==
Surabat was a tiny [[City|settlement]] in the [[Surabat River Valley]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Batuu]].<ref name="Traveler's Guide" /> It was a beautiful location, but wild, remote, and isolated with harsh weather conditions, including most [[Standard day|days]] being windy and the [[winter]] seasons being snowy. The vicinity was surrounded by valleys, giant spires and [[mountain]]s. During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], the town had few modern conveniences.<ref name="GEStaff">[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] has official backstory elements that, though not directly published for the public, are officially canon details that can be obtained verbally from cast members working in the land.</ref>

Housing in the vicinity included apartment buildings built into large spires that could house several families, large houses that were occupied by single families. There were also small houses made of wood and mud similar in design to the architecture found in Black Spire Outpost, some of which underground rooms.<ref name="GEStaff" />

==History==
Local legends claimed that Surabat was the location where several children were known to have disappeared decades before, however residents were rarely known to discuss the event with outsiders.<ref name="Traveler's Guide" />

==Inhabitants==
The residents of Surabat were strong, hardy and reserved individuals who built their homes nestled against the base of the giant spires and [[mountain]]s that surrounded the settlement. Many came from families involved in [[Plant|crop]] [[farm]]ing and raising livestock.<ref name="GEStaff" />

A large number of residents were involved in the dangerous work of harvesting the [[Golden Lichen]] that grew on the spires near their homes, although some of the inhabitants traveled an [[Standard hour|hour]] away by [[transport]] into Black Spire Outpost for work. Those that commuted met each day at the vicinity's depot and boarded a [[shuttle]] belonging to [[Oga Garra]], who owned [[Oga's Cantina]] in the outpost. Once the work day was over, the shuttle would also carry the residents home.<ref name="GEStaff" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Surabat was created as part of the backstory for [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], a theme park land that opened to guests on [[May 31]], [[2019]] at [[Disneyland]] Park, and [[August 29]], 2019 at [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]], [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]].<ref name="GEStaff" />
